direction: Cinematic wood-fired bakery imagery with a pre-dawn glow: smoky, ember-warm lighting in brand hues (burnt orange #c2410c and dark brown #78350f), wheat highlights #fef3c7, and near-black shadows #1c1917. Use a photographic style with subtle film grain, shallow depth of field, and crisp textures on cracked crust and flour dust. Mood is early-morning Leith craft—embers, soot-speckled brick, and gentle steam—while keeping backgrounds simple and low-detail so the bread remains the clear hero.

slots.alt: Bakers loading loaves into a wood-fired oven before dawn
slots.subject: Bakers loading loaves
slots.prompt: Bakers loading wood-fired sourdough loaves into a glowing brick oven, pre-dawn atmosphere with drifting steam and ember light. Composition: keep the entire left 45% as a calm, dark shadowy brick background (very low detail, near-black #1c1917) for a clean white text overlay contrast; place the action on the right. Close, documentary feel with warm rim light in #c2410c and deep browns #78350f; no text.

slots.alt: A dark rye loaf with a cracked crust
slots.subject: Dark rye sourdough loaf
slots.prompt: Dark rye sourdough loaf with a deeply cracked crust, flour lightly dusted, steam faint in warm ember light. 4:3 framing: loaf centered, angled slightly to show crack lines and blistered surface. Background is a softly blurred dark wooden peel and soot-speckled brick, low detail, tinted with near-black #1c1917 and warm browns #78350f; subtle highlights in wheat #fef3c7. Photographic, shallow depth of field. No text or labels.

slots.alt: A round country sourdough dusted with flour
slots.subject: Floured country boule
slots.prompt: Round country sourdough boule dusted with flour, rustic scoring, airy rustic crumb hinted at a torn edge. Place the loaf in the middle with gentle diagonal lift for depth. Background: minimalist linen cloth and warm oven glow, blurred, using wheat #fef3c7 highlights and deep ember browns #78350f. Lighting is soft and directional, emphasizing texture and cracks; shallow DOF, subtle film grain. No words or branding.

slots.subject: Cardamom buns on tray
slots.prompt: Cardamom buns, glossy and glazed with twisted spirals, arranged on a wooden tray near the edge of a wood-fired oven. 4:3 framing: buns slightly off-center for space, with steam and embers creating warm bokeh. Palette stays within #c2410c amber glow and #78350f browns, with creamy highlights #fef3c7 on the glaze. Background is dark and low-detail to keep buns clearly recognizable. Photoreal, shallow depth of field, no text.

slots.alt: Crumb & Ember: wood-fired sourdough in Leith
slots.subject: Leith wood-fired sourdough scene
slots.prompt: Crumb & Ember style wood-fired sourdough in a Leith-inspired setting: an open oven mouth with glowing coals, two or three loaves on a wooden peel mid-transfer, and a baker’s hands in soot-lit warmth. Wide 1.9:1 composition: let the top sky/oven arch be darker and less detailed in near-black #1c1917; focus light on the loaves using ember orange #c2410c and crust browns #78350f, wheat highlights #fef3c7. Cinematic photo, subtle grain, no text.
